result.rationale: The diff adds `totalPages: ... Math.floor(this.get("user_count") / this.get("limit")) + 1` in admin-group.js.es6. When user_count is an exact multiple of limit (e.g., 100/50), this yields 3 pages when only 2 exist, and `showingLast` (currentPage == totalPages) will never be true on page 2, so the next button remains clickable and `next` computes offset = min(100, 100) = 100, requesting an empty page. Correct formula is ceil(user_count/limit).

record.issue_text: Client totalPages computation floor(user_count / limit) + 1 has an off-by-one when user_count is an exact multiple of limit (e.g. 100 users, limit 50 → empty page 3)

adjudication.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, `totalPages` is computed as `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1` (when `user_count > 0`). For exact multiples (e.g. 100 users, limit 50), this yields 3 instead of 2. The `next` action also allows `offset` to become exactly `user_count` (`Math.min(offset + limit, user_count)`), and `findMembers` then queries with that offset, which will return an empty `members` list. This creates an empty extra page, matching the finding.
